multimodal.label: Multimodal transport
multimodal.hint: The cargo travels by more than one mode, for example truck plus vessel. This adds an MTD document.

multimodalStructure.question: How is the carriage organised?
multimodalStructure.hint: This determines which transport documents we generate.

single.title: One carrier for the whole route
single.desc: A single contract covers all legs.

separate.title: Separate contracts per leg
separate.desc: Each leg has its own carrier.

multimodalStructure.docsPreviewHint: Full list once the cargo details are filled in
multimodalStructure.docsPreviewEmpty: Fill in the legs in the "Cargo" step to see a preview of the documents.

route.switchBody: You have already filled in details for {{from}}. Switching to {{to}} clears them, because they do not apply to the new mode.

sea.title: Container and voyage details
sea.hint: These fields are optional. The carrier issues this data, so you can fill it in later.

incoterms.title: Incoterms
incoterms.hint: The trade rule that splits costs and risk between consignor and consignee

rail.title: Rail details
rail.hint: Stations and wagons go onto the CIM consignment note.
rail.groupConsignment: Group consignment (several wagons under one note)

air.title: Air details
air.hint: Airports and weight go onto the air waybill (AWB).

multimodal.title: Legs of the journey
multimodal.hint: The order matters: the first leg is the pre-carriage, the second is the main carriage and the last is the on-carriage on the multimodal transport document.
multimodal.needsLegMode: You chose separate contracts per leg — select at least one mode of transport

parties.fillFasterLink: add your company details to your profile
parties.autofilled: Filled in from your profile. You can change it.
parties.autofilledCompleteLink: Complete the rest of your company details
parties.autofilledCompleteSuffix: so that next time everything is filled in.
parties.carrierSubtitle: Required. Appears on the CMR, transport order and POD

quote.title: Quote
quote.portNotRecognised: We could not match a port to this route. Check the rates on the Trade lanes tab.
quote.roadSoon: Road freight quotes are coming soon. Sea and air rates are on the Trade lanes tab.

docs.docsChangedBody: After your changes the list of required and optional documents differs from the original. Check the selection before you generate.
docs.savedBody: The document set has been saved.
docs.insuranceBody: Protect the cargo in transit against damage, theft and loss.
docs.selectAtLeastOne: Select at least one document to download the files.
docs.saveFailed: We could not save the set to your history.

guard.title: Unfinished form
guard.body: The data you entered has not been generated yet. Save the current progress as a draft so you can come back to it?
guard.saveFailed: We could not save the draft.
